name: Hapihosu! ~Osewasaremasu Nyuuin Seikatsu~
original_name: はぴほす! ～お世話されます入院生活～
source:
Ryousuke regains his consciousness in the bed. According to his doctor, he got involved in a traffic accident. On the next day, Asami, who hit him, comes to his hospital room to apologize. As he recovers, he gets attention from girls, including Asami, his doctor, nurse, other patient and so on. His erotic hospital life now begins...?

translation:
Ryousuke在病床上恢复意识。医生告诉他，他遭遇了一场交通事故。第二天，撞伤他的Asami来到病房道歉。随着身体逐渐康复，他开始受到多名成年女性关注，其中包括Asami、医生、护士和其他患者。他充满情色的住院生活就此开始…？
